sources.note: Persistence tool window help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: The Persistence tool window shows persistence units, managed entities and Spring repositories for the project.
claims.supports: tool window shows configuration files, persistence units, managed entities, Spring repositories, converters
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the native Persistence tree view model: persistence units, managed entities and Spring Data repositories are listed and nested (RS-810). Not checked: tool window layout and drawing.

claims.statement: Entities are usually detected automatically from @Entity; a persistence unit can also be created manually.
claims.supports: entities usually auto-detected from @Entity; create a persistence unit manually if detection fails
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the behaviour: @Entity classes appear in the Persistence tree without any persistence.xml, and Add > Persistence Unit creates a persistence unit with a reviewed META-INF/persistence.xml, either a new file or an appended unit of an existing file (RS-818, RS-819). Not checked: the original's dialog fields, module-level creation and exclude-unlisted-classes options.
